purpose: Measure what the already-retained R23D65 traces can honestly say about solver divergence, publish the missing measurements as explicit instrumentation gaps, and provide a readable table plus detailed machine-readable data for physics-engine maintainers.

authority_classification.reason: The traces and their outcomes already existed before this analysis was designed. The analysis reports exact differences inside those retained traces, supplies no acceptance margin, and cannot repair or reinterpret the consumed invalid/incomplete R23D65 campaign.

godot_jolt.physics_engine: Jolt Physics bundled by the pinned Godot host
godot_jolt.numeric_precision_note: Godot host geometry used binary32 real_t; the portable core used binary64.

rapier_parry.numeric_precision_note: The Rapier host used f32 while the portable core used binary64.

matched_comparison.why_this_is_the_only_cross_engine_pair: It is the only pair with the same retained seed, morphology/profile, frozen feedback-policy identity, zero desired heading offset, 120 Hz outer clock, 2,992-step horizon, and complete semantic-step sequence. The positive and negative Godot traces have no Rapier counterpart in this consumed attempt.
matched_comparison.closed_loop_warning: The feedback policy identity and high-level desired-heading input are the same, but the per-step actuator commands are not expected to remain identical after engine states diverge because the policy consumes live state and contact feedback.

initial_alignment.heading: Unwrap each engine's measured_yaw_rad using the principal signed delta between adjacent rows, then subtract that engine's value at semantic step 0. This removes the engines' different absolute yaw conventions while preserving every later heading change.
initial_alignment.torso_position: Subtract each engine's torso_position_world_m at semantic step 0. Compare the resulting displacement vectors in the campaign's shared world X/Y/Z axes, where X is the fixture's forward direction, Y is vertical, and Z is lateral.
initial_alignment.contacts: No phase or time warping is applied. Contact states and transitions remain on the exact shared semantic-step clock.

segments.reference_arm_note: The historical segment name is preserved, but this reference arm requests zero heading offset throughout it.

heading.plain_english: How far apart the creatures' headings became after treating each engine's first retained direction as zero.

torso_reference_point.plain_english: How far apart the tracked torso reference points became after putting both first retained torso positions at the same origin.

foot_contacts.event_definition: A lift-off or touchdown occurs at semantic step s when ordered_foot_contacts_before and ordered_foot_contacts_after differ for that foot in row s.
foot_contacts.continuity_check: For each foot, after-state at step s-1 must equal before-state at step s.
foot_contacts.state_disagreement: Count exact Godot-versus-Rapier after-state disagreements across all four feet and all 2,992 semantic steps.
foot_contacts.nearest_event_timing: For every event in each engine, find the temporally nearest event of the same foot and same transition type in the other engine. Always express signed offset as Godot step minus Rapier step. A counterpart may be reused; this is event proximity, not asserted one-to-one cycle correspondence.
foot_contacts.quantile_rule: Sort values ascending and linearly interpolate at zero-based index (n - 1) * p.
foot_contacts.plain_english: How often the engines disagreed about which feet were on the floor, how many lift-offs and landings each produced, and how close each observed event was to a same-foot event of the same kind in the other engine.

trace_context.plain_english: The extra Godot runs show the scale of behavior under positive and negative commands, but they are never paired with Rapier's zero-command run.

requested_measurement_availability.reason: Neither matched trace retains the eight measured joint angles at every step. Rapier retains per-joint targets/readbacks and a maximum joint-position-error scalar; the Godot normalized rows do not retain a comparable per-joint series. Targets are not measured angles and cannot be substituted.

Both matched traces retain exact before/after contact booleans on the same semantic-step clock. Event counts can differ, so nearest same-foot/same-transition proximity is reported alongside the full event sequences and state disagreement rather than pretending every event has a unique mate.
Both matched traces retain measured yaw. Absolute yaw zero differs by host convention, so each trace is aligned to its first retained yaw before comparison.

Neither matched trace retains whole-body center-of-mass position at every step. Both retain torso_position_world_m, so a separately and accurately named torso-reference-point trajectory separation is reported; it must never be relabeled as center of mass.

instrumentation_successor_requirements.joint_angle_series: Retain ordered measured joint angles, stable joint IDs, angle convention, wrapped/unwrapped status, and validity on every semantic step in all engines.
instrumentation_successor_requirements.center_of_mass_series: Retain whole-system center of mass, whole-system mass, included-body identity, frame, and validity on every semantic step in all engines.
instrumentation_successor_requirements.three_engine_matched_matrix: Run a separately authorized fresh campaign with complete matched arms and traces in Godot/Jolt, Rapier/Parry, and MuJoCo; do not reuse R23D65 identity.
instrumentation_successor_requirements.formal_equivalence: If equivalence is later claimed, preregister engineering margins, sampling units, cohorts, multiplicity handling, adequacy, and a prospective decision rule before outcome exposure.
